page0.text:
...
...We have to accept his offer.
Even if he is an enemy, his argument is correct.
Tohsaka and I alone can't beat Caster.
But there should be some hope if we have Lancer's help.

page1.text:
"...All right. I also don't have any complaints."
I turn off the Magic Circuits connected to my whole body and relax my shoulders.
That's the most sincere thing I can do.
That I have no intention to fight...
The expression of will that as long as we are cooperating, I can defenselessly show my back to him.

page2.text:
"...I see, this is seriously bad. You must be going through a lot of trouble, young lady."
"Oh, can you tell? I'm glad, I finally met someone who understands. I was afraid that things might stay like this until the very end."

page3.text:
"That's unfortunate. But, he's not bad for a guy.
When you're a kid, you can be as stupid as a fool.
You can learn stuff and get twisted after that."
